_comment_harvest_days: FALLBACK ONLY. Flat days-until-ready, used only when GDD estimation is disabled or the weather lookup fails.
_comment_gdd: Growing-degree-day harvest estimation (preferred; see growing_degree_days.py). Set 'enabled' to false to use the flat harvest_days table above instead.

gdd._comment_location: Defaults to Sunyani, Ghana. Change to your farm's coordinates. Set latitude/longitude to null to skip live weather and always use assumed_avg_temp_c.
gdd._comment_gdd_required: Heat units (base 10C) needed from the CURRENT stage to reach harvest-ready, per typical tomato heat-unit guides. Tune per variety once you have a season of ground-truth harvest dates to calibrate against.

_comment_tracking: Track lifecycle thresholds (see TrackState in tracker_core.py). confirm_after_observations filters single-frame noise before it's ever counted as a tomato -- raise this for the live camera feed, which has many frames to judge from. lost_after_missed_frames tolerates brief occlusion without dropping the tomato from the live count. exit_after_missed_frames is how long a missing track is kept before being marked 'exited' and dropped from currently_in_frame_count (it still remains in the session's historical total).
_comment_disease: Heuristic disease/anomaly screening (see disease_detector.py). This is a color-based screen, not a trained classifier -- see that file's docstring.
_comment_display: Visual settings for the live overlay
_comment_live_state: Path to a small JSON file rewritten periodically for the Streamlit dashboard to poll.
_comment_stale: If live_state.json hasn't been rewritten in this many seconds, the detector is treated as stopped/disconnected rather than 'live', even though the file still exists.
